description: Run when code can't find or read a transaction that is on chain, or before relying on code that reads other people's transactions. Says whether a transaction is legacy, version 0 or version 1, and which readers (RPC settings and library versions) can read it. Example: {"tx_id": "<signature>"}  or  {"tx": "<base64 transaction>"}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/tx_version.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

tx.description: A raw transaction, signed or not. Give this or tx_id. The bytes a wallet or builder gave you, base64-encoded.

tx_id.description: A landed transaction's signature. Give this or tx. Returned when it was sent, or from history. Never make one up.

name: tx_version
